rationale: All 9 blocking findings are resolved: CR-005, CR-006 and CR-007 by source and tests read at HEAD 9fa3f17b, the other six by recorded decisions with rationale. Confidence is medium because those decisions leave work open: the security sign-off for CR-001 is still a pre-merge step, and CR-002 and CR-004 keep behavior the EPMCDME-16545 criteria still mark partial without amending them. The npm run ci record names reviewed_head 522954bb rather than HEAD, so it was not used as proof and this round ran no commands.
